title: Players see their campaign's name
summary: In a shared room, players now see the DM's campaign name instead of "Party overview".
items: The join card reads "Joining The Wayfarers" once your characters are found.
The header's campaign button, the Campaign screen and the browser tab ("Mira · The Wayfarers") show the campaign's name.
My account names each saved membership after its campaign.
A campaign the DM has not named shows as "Shared campaign" and its room code.
